- **Composer Provider Butt"},{"id":"p2s2","text":"on Visibility Setting (`showProviderPill`) (#519)**: Added an accessible toggle in the General tab o"},{"id":"p2s3","text":"f Image Generation settings to show or hide the quick provider/model switcher button in the chat inp"},{"id":"p2s4","text":"ut composer. Changing visibility preserves configured provider, model, generation tools, and gallery"},{"id":"p2s5","text":" capabilities without disabling the plugin."},{"id":"p3s1","text":"## 🚀 Updates v0.12.9: Full DSH Desktop Electron Compatibility (#478)
- **DSH Desktop Scheme Authoriz"},{"id":"p3s2","text":"ation**: Extended `isTrustedLocalRequest`, `getRouteRejectionStatus`, and `getRouteWriteRejectionSta"},{"id":"p3s3","text":"tus` to authorize the privileged `dsh-app://app/` custom scheme from local loopback connections.
- *"},{"id":"p3s4","text":"*Desktop Endpoint & Image Unblocking**: Unblocks `/dsh-image-gen/image`, `/dsh-image-gen/approval`, "},{"id":"p3s5","text":"`/dsh-image-gen/vault`, and `/dsh-image-gen/config` from HTTP 403 Forbidden under Electron, restorin"},{"id":"p3s6","text":"g thumbnail rendering, Interactive Approval Gate actions, and Studio Vault functionality in DSH Desk"},{"id":"p3s7","text":"top.
- **Fail-Closed Security Invariant**: Untrusted non-loopback LAN origins and spoofed custom sch"},{"id":"p3s8","text":"emes (`evil-scheme://`, `dsh-app://untrusted.host`) remain strictly rejected with HTTP 403 Forbidden"},{"id":"p3s9","text":"mes (`evil-scheme://`, `dsh-app://untrusted.host`) remain strictly rejected with HTTP 403 Forbidden."},{"id":"p4s1","text":"## 🚀 Updates v0.10.26: Architecture Decomposition & Repository Sanitization (#235, #238, #239)
* **A"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"rchitecture & Modular Decomposition (#239)**: All server modules in `lib/` now strictly meet the <= "},{"id":"p4s3","text":"600 line threshold: extracted `lib/tools/generation-pack.js` (74 lines, reduces `lib/tools/generatio"},{"id":"p4s4","text":"n.js` to 547 lines), `lib/history.js` (93 lines), and `lib/attachment-helper.js` (82 lines, reduces "},{"id":"p4s5","text":"`lib/index.js` to 557 lines). Client codebase modularized across 15 sub-modules in `src/client/*` (a"},{"id":"p4s6","text":"ll <= 337 lines).
* **Repository Sanitization (#235)**: Internal agent workflow files (`AGENTS.md`, "},{"id":"p4s7","text":"`index.md`) fully untracked from Git and excluded via `.gitignore` and `.gitattributes`.
* **Theme P"},{"id":"p4s8","text":"arity Completed (#238)**: Full verification and closure of zero-standalone-color rule across all Web"},{"id":"p4s9","text":" UI surfaces with native `--dsw-alias-*` variables and `color-mix(...)` state tints.
* **Package Int"},{"id":"p4s10","text":"egrity**: Added canonical `README.ru.md` and `README.zh.md` to npm package `files` allowlist."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"## ⚡ Overview"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"**`@goodandready/dsh-image-gen`** is a premier graphic generation and visual processing suite for De"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"epSeek Harness. It equips autonomous agents with an extensible set of tools for image generation, tr"},{"id":"p6s3","text":"ansformation, background removal, upscaling, vectorization, multi-reference blending, and quality in"},{"id":"p6s4","text":"spection across 8 generative backends."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"### 🚀 What's New in v0.10.7 (#197)
* **Robust Error Formatting**: completely prevents `[object Objec"},{"id":"p7s2","text":"t]` from appearing in provider refusal chains, extracting deep `.message`, `.detail`, and `.error` o"},{"id":"p7s3","text":"bjects cleanly.
* **Deduplicated Provider Prefixes**: eliminates redundant `codex: codex: ...` prefi"},{"id":"p7s4","text":"xes.
* **FAL Credential Aliasing**: seamless fallback between `FAL_API_KEY` and `FAL_KEY` in credent"},{"id":"p7s5","text":"ials and environment.
* **Subscription Aspect Ratio Mapping**: maps aspect ratios (`16:9`, `3:2`, `9"},{"id":"p7s6","text":":16`, `2:3`) to appropriate subscription dimensions (`1536x1024` / `1024x1536`) instead of falling b"},{"id":"p7s7","text":"ack to default square `1024x1024`."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"### 🚀 What's New in v0.10.16
* **Safe Attachment Service Fallback (#214)**: Added graceful fallback "},{"id":"p8s2","text":"handling in `saveAttachmentSafe` across all 8 visual tools (`generate_image`, variations, `remove_ba"},{"id":"p8s3","text":"ckground`, `upscale_image`, `blend_images`, etc.). When running in headless CLI mode or when the att"},{"id":"p8s4","text":"achment store is unavailable, outputs are safely written to disk with full file paths and data refer"},{"id":"p8s5","text":"ences rather than crashing tool execution.
* **HTTP Image Endpoint Strict Validation**: Hardened `/d"},{"id":"p8s6","text":"sh-image-gen/image` route against malformed or NaN parameters (`b`, `w`, `h`), cleanly responding wi"},{"id":"p8s7","text":"th HTTP 400 or 404 without leaking internal system traces.
* **ComfyUI Node Error Extraction**: Inte"},{"id":"p8s8","text":"grated `extractComfyNodeErrors` to parse node execution errors from `/history/{pid}` status response"},{"id":"p8s9","text":"s, immediately reporting root-cause node diagnostics rather than timing out.
* **Custom Provider Err"},{"id":"p8s10","text":"or Normalization**: Standardized gateway error extracts through `formatErrorMessage`, eliminating ra"},{"id":"p8s11","text":"w JSON or `[object Object]` artifacts on 4xx/5xx API responses.
* **Cache & History Consistency**: E"},{"id":"p8s12","text":"nsured content-addressed disk cache hits synchronize seamlessly with generation history and sidecar "},{"id":"p8s13","text":"metadata.
* **Test Suite Expansion**: Added `test/batch4-hardening.test.mjs`, expanding test coverag"},{"id":"p8s14","text":"e to **128 automated unit tests (100% pass)**."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"### 🚀 What's New in v0.11.12
* **Character Sheet Generator (`generate_character_sheet`, #181)**: Syn"},{"id":"p9s2","text":"thesizes consistent character turnaround and model sheets (1x3, 2x2, emotions) preserving facial fea"},{"id":"p9s3","text":"tures and attire across anime, 3D, concept, and comic styles.
* **FaceID & Portrait Consistency (`fa"},{"id":"p9s4","text":"ce_reference`, #183)**: FaceID / IP-Adapter prompt directives and `face` anchor mode in `set_style_a"},{"id":"p9s5","text":"nchor` for persistent facial likeness across scenes.
* **OCR Localization & Text Replacement (`repla"},{"id":"p9s6","text":"ce_image_text`, #180)**: Automated OCR text detection via `dsh-vision-bridge`, seamless background i"},{"id":"p9s7","text":"npainting, and crisp typography replacement at original coordinates.
* **3D Isometric Diagram Beauti"},{"id":"p9s8","text":"fier (`beautify_diagram`, #185)**: Converts raw Mermaid/Graphviz architecture diagrams into stunning"},{"id":"p9s9","text":" 3D isometric tech illustrations for documentation and hero headers.
* **Interactive Inpainting Canv"},{"id":"p9s10","text":"as (#328)**: In-chat masking overlay with aspect ratio auto-detection, adjustable brush/eraser, and "},{"id":"p9s11","text":"direct prompt dispatch.
* **Live Progress Stream (#329)**: Real-time progress bar, stage indicators,"},{"id":"p9s12","text":" and denoising step counters in `FalImageCard`."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"### 🚀 What's New in v0.11.9
* **ComfyUI Local Backend Payload Fix (#322, GitHub #7)**: Eliminated re"},{"id":"p10s2","text":"dundant nesting in `lib/providers/backends/local.js` that wrapped workflows as `{ prompt: { prompt: "},{"id":"p10s3","text":"workflowGraph } }`, resolving `missing_node_type: Node 'ID #prompt' has no class_type` HTTP 400 erro"},{"id":"p10s4","text":"rs during local ComfyUI generations.
